research_notes: When actual task duration exceeds estimate, overshoot should be attributed to admission error rather than runtime boundary movement unless the hard cap itself is implicated.
When the policy hands off too early despite spare safe budget, record unnecessary early handoff separately.
This allows policy quality to be optimized without confusing it with platform safety.
A stable hard envelope plus measurable admission errors is easier to debug than a single opaque utilization metric.
The current strict boundary program establishes that envelope first.
No change to current target classification is made by these policy-stage observations.
